basic_details.short_information: Lal Bahadur Shastri Hospital (LBSH), Khichripur, Delhi – 110091, under the Government of NCT of Delhi, will hold a walk-in interview on 23 October 2026. Applications will be accepted from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM in the Administration Branch, LBSH, and no application will be taken after that time. The interview will fill 7 Senior Resident posts on an ad-hoc basis in Obs & Gynae, Peadiatrics, Medicine, Surgery and Anesthesia. The pay is as per 7th CPC, Pay Matrix Level 11, plus other admissible allowances.

important_instructions: The appointment is ad-hoc. Each term is 44 days, and the post can be extended up to 3 years, subject to satisfactory performance and as per applicable rules. The 44-day term can be extended for a further 44 days, with a 1-day break. This needs a written request from the doctor, recommended and forwarded by the in-charge concerned. Extensions continue until a regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier. The maximum is 3 years, counting any earlier service as a Senior Resident (ad-hoc or regular) in any NMC-recognised teaching or non-teaching institution. The tenure follows the Residency Scheme of GOI dated 5 June 1992 and the extended Residency Scheme notified vide circular No. F. No. 121/26/2010/H&FW/DSHFW/1996-2045, dated 10 June 2011. Either party can end the ad-hoc appointment by giving seven days' notice, without assigning any reason. Selected candidates shall be allowed a maximum of 7 days from the date of issue of the result. Joining is subject to being declared medically fit by the Staff Physician, LBSH. The selected candidate must give an undertaking that he/she is not working at any Government or private health care facility at the time of joining. The undertaking also states that he/she will not work at any such facility during the tenure at LBSH. If this is found to be untrue, strict action, including termination of service, will be taken. Selected candidates can be posted anywhere in patient care or in the public interest in an emergency.

Seats will be reserved for SC, ST, OBC (Delhi, with a valid NCL certificate) and specially abled candidates, as per the prevailing conditions/guidelines, on an ad-hoc basis for 44 days. Only OBC/EWS certificates issued by the Govt. of NCT of Delhi will be accepted. They must have been issued before the date of the interview. If no SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates are available, the post will be filled from any other suitable candidate of the unreserved/other category. If an SC/ST/OBC/EWS certificate is found to be fake or false, services will be terminated at once without further reason. Further action may also be taken under the Indian Penal Code.
The Competent Authority reserves the right to amend or cancel the interview. The Competent Authority reserves the right to decide any dispute about the selection process.

content_sections.heading: About LBSH
content_sections.text: Lal Bahadur Shastri Hospital (LBSH) is a hospital of the Government of NCT of Delhi at Khichripur, Delhi – 110091. The office of its Medical Superintendent issued this notice, dated 21 October 2026. It was signed by Dr. Meenakshi Kamal, Dy. Medical Superintendent (O), with the prior approval of the Medical Superintendent.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: All 7 Senior Resident posts are ad-hoc. The notice gives the vacancies department by department, with a category break-up. All posts have the same qualification, age limit and pay. The number of vacancies may change according to the actual vacancy position at the time of the interview. MBBS with a Post Graduate Degree/DNB/Diploma or Post-Doctoral Degree (or equivalent) in the concerned specialty from an NMC/MCI recognised University/Institute. DMC registration for the concerned specialty/super specialty. The tenure of the PG Degree/DNB/Diploma or Post-Doctoral Degree or equivalent must be completed, and the result must be declared, before the date of interview. If candidates with MBBS and a Post Graduate Degree/DNB/Diploma or Post-Doctoral Degree or equivalent are not available, candidates with an MBBS degree and 2 (two) years' experience in the same specialty can be considered. Relaxation of the criteria is as per Circular No. F. No. 121/26/2010/H&FW/1996-2045, dated 10 June 2011, issued by the Health & Family Welfare Department, Govt. NCT of Delhi. Only an OBC certificate (Delhi) issued by the Govt. of NCT of Delhi will be considered. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, see the official notification.

rows.pay_level_pay: As per 7th CPC, Pay Matrix Level 11 (Rs. 67,700 – 2,008,700) and other admissible allowances per month

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Bring the application in the prescribed application format, along with the originals and self-attested photocopies of these documents: 10th Certificate MBBS Degree Post Graduate Degree DMC registration certificate, or the acknowledgement of DMC registration Caste Certificate Valid NCL certificate (for OBC (Delhi) candidates) Proof of awards/publications, if applicable Identity proof, such as an Aadhar Card or a Voter ID Card Two passport size photographs Candidates who are working in any organisation must produce an NOC from their present employer.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid to candidates called for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the LBSH Senior Resident walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 23 October 2026 at the Administration Branch, LBSH, Khichripur, Delhi – 110091. Applications are accepted from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM only.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in LBSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 7 Senior Resident vacancies: 3 in Obs & Gynae and 1 each in Peadiatrics, Medicine, Surgery and Anesthesia. The number may change as per the actual vacancy position at the time of the interview.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the LBSH Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: You need MBBS with a PG Degree/DNB/Diploma or Post-Doctoral Degree (or equivalent) in the concerned specialty from an NMC/MCI recognised University/Institute, plus DMC registration. If no such candidates are available, candidates with MBBS and 2 years' experience in the same specialty can be considered.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the LBSH Senior Resident walk-in?
faq.answer: You must not be more than 45 years old as on the date of advertisement. OBC candidates with a valid NCL certificate get 3 years' relaxation, and SC/ST candidates get 5 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Senior Resident at LBSH?
faq.answer: The pay is as per 7th CPC, Pay Matrix Level 11 (Rs. 67,700 – 2,008,700), plus other admissible allowances per month.

faq.question: Q6. Which documents should I bring to the LBSH walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring the application in the prescribed format, with originals and self-attested photocopies of these: 10th Certificate, MBBS Degree, PG Degree, DMC registration (or its acknowledgement), Caste Certificate, NCL certificate for OBC (Delhi), proof of awards/publications if applicable, identity proof and two passport size photographs.

faq.question: Q7. How will LBSH select Senior Residents?
faq.answer: Selection is through the interview only. A rank list will be made, and it stays valid for one month from the date of the result or until the next advertisement for the same post, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any fee for the LBSH Senior Resident interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says there is no fee for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is the LBSH Senior Resident job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is ad-hoc, for 44 days at a time, and can be extended up to a maximum of 3 years, subject to satisfactory performance and as per applicable rules. Either party can end it with seven days' notice.

faq.question: Q10. Will an OBC certificate from another state be accepted at LBSH?
faq.answer: No. Only an OBC certificate (Delhi) issued by the Govt. of NCT of Delhi will be considered. It must have been issued before the date of the interview.
